thread:
ana: Heads-up: we've updated the Performance Review & Calibration section in the handbook and rolled out a short 20-minute mandatory micro-training for all people managers and reviewers. Handbook link: https://handbook.redwood.company/performance-calibration 

ana: Training focuses on calibration norms, rating guidance, and unconscious bias awareness. Managers who run calibration panels should complete before the next review cycle.

rachel: Quick Q: does this apply to IC reviewers on peer panels or only direct managers?

ana: Applies to anyone serving on an official review panel (managers, directors, IC reviewers). Peer feedback-only reviewers are optional but encouraged.

dave: Will completion be visible on the performance dashboard? I need to filter panels by completed reviewers.

ana: Yes  tracker will expose reviewer completion flags. We'll include `reviewer_email, role, team_size, completed_at, exemption_note` in the CSV export.

li: Contractors who serve as panel reviewers (long-term consultants) 1099s with accounts 12 included?

ana: If they have Redwood accounts and are assigned to a panel, yes. Otherwise no. If you need a temporary account for a reviewer, DM people-ops.

chris: Someone asked about exemptions for recent training: I led a bias workshop external to Redwood last month. Can that count?

ana: If you attended an equivalent course within 90 days, send certification to people-ops@redwood.com and we'll mark you exempt. Subject: "Calibration Training Exemption 025".

people-ops-bot: Automated assignment: 189 users assigned to "Performance Calibration & Bias Training (20min)". Due: 2025-12-01. Tracker: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (snapshot 2025-11-15 16:22 UTC) :bell:

rachel: Reminders cadence? escalation?

ana: We'll send an initial assignment, then reminders at 7 days and 48 hours left. Missed > 14 days = manager follow-up + soft flag on the performance admin dashboard. Repeated misses will be discussed with HRBP.

dave: For the CSV can you also add a `panel_assigned` column? helps me join with review schedules.

ana: Good idea 1 added `panel_assigned` and `panel_date` to the export. Example header: `reviewer_email,role,team_size,completed_at,panel_assigned,panel_date,exemption_note`.

li: Any accommodation options for reviewers who need extra time due to caregiving or time zone barriers?

ana: Yes please use people-ops-accomms@redwood.com to request an extension; we'll reflect `extension_requested` in the export.

chris: Will there be a short changelog for the handbook update so I can include it in the manager digest?

ana: Yep 1 changelog at the bottom of the handbook page. Suggested blurb: "Updated performance calibration guidance + mandatory 20-min bias training for reviewers and managers. Completion tracked; deadline 2025-12-01." Feel free to shorten.

rachel: Thanks. I'll pull the CSV after the next snapshot and surface panel-level completion in the calibration readout.

ana: Thanks all. Ping me with any edge cases. :sparkles:
